lines: How is a SIF different from a PMS?

A PMS needs ₹50 lakh and holds shares in your name. A SIF pools money into units under mutual fund rules. An AIF is a private placement at ₹1 crore with a long lock-in. A SIF sets its redemption terms in the offer document.
